entities.summary: "A Different Corner" is a song written and performed by English singer and songwriter George Michael, released on 24 March 1986 by Epic Records in the UK and Columbia Records in the US. It was Michael's second solo single release following "Careless Whisper" (1984), and reached number one on the UK singles chart.
